rejilla.formato: float32 little-endian, NaN = no data, longitude east positive

metrica.desviacion_pct: min(100, |f(v_Earth) − f(v_target)| / (f(max) − f(min)) × 100), f = transformacion (lineal: v; log10: log10(max(v, min)); log1p: log10(1 + max(v, 0))), [min, max] = rango_ref
metrica.similitud_pct: 100 − desviacion_pct; cell similarity = weighted mean over the used parameters with data; a cell is ranked only if it has data for every used parameter, cells with at least half of them are listed apart as partly compared
